title: Animal Coats
description: A generator of the patterned coats of the animal kingdom, stripes and spots in one place — zebra, tiger, okapi and brindle stripes; cheetah spots; leopard and jaguar rosettes; and the cracked-mosaic patches of a giraffe; and the bold black blotches of a poison dart frog on vivid blue. Biologists model all of these as Turing (reaction–diffusion) patterns, the same chemistry tuned to lay down bands, dots or a mosaic, and it's built here procedurally on a fragment shader: stripes are a directional wave, domain-warped for the waver and given phase dislocations for the Y-forks; spots and rosettes are an animated Voronoi field of irregular dots or broken rings with a warm centre (and an inner spot for jaguar); giraffe is Voronoi cells filled brown with pale cracks between them. A species preset picks the family, colours and character, and a Pattern switch can force stripes, spots, rosettes or giraffe onto any palette. Scale, waver, forking, curve, mark width, softness, orientation, flow and fur grain are live — leave flow at zero for a still coat or drive it with the music.
